dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: A single, thick, high-contrast light horizontal band is visible across the greater coverts.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Prominent pale edges on the folded flight feathers create a series of sharp, high-contrast diagonal boundaries against the dark feather bodies.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A distinct, linear boundary separates the pale grey crown from the dark charcoal mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: The forehead and anterior crown feature a high-contrast pale grey/white patch that terminates abruptly at the mid-vertex.
